prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a modern car dashboard display, focusing on a digital warning message. At the center of the screen, a minimalist white icon of a steaming coffee cup is shown above the text "Rest recommended" in clean, sans-serif font. The background is a deep, matte black, creating a high-contrast effect that makes the icon and text stand out crisply. On the left edge of the frame, the blurred outline of a speedometer with red and white markings is partially visible, adding context and depth to the composition. The lighting is low and moody, with subtle reflections suggesting the interior of a vehicle at night or in dim conditions. The overall style is sleek and modern, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the digital display, evoking a sense of quiet alertness and technological sophistication.
